primary.title: Greed and Fear Report: Chris Wood-led Jefferies sees IT earnings soaring 65% on AI boom but flags this as a key risk
primary.summary: The technology sector faces a pivotal moment with strong AI-driven earnings growth countered by rising bond yields. Analysts highlight the need to evaluate long-term returns on substantial AI capital expenditures amidst tightening financial conditions that could pressure equity valuations.
